findings.title: Collides with Lumen Small Finance Bank Ltd: Credit risk monitoring non-compete for RBI Regulated Lenders in India
findings.impact: Collides with the Lumen non-compete commitment, which runs for 24 months from 31 July 2026 through 31 July 2028.

citations.quote: The Service Provider represents that it is not party to any agreement that restricts it from performing the Services, and that its performance will not breach any obligation owed to a third party

Without limiting Clause 10.1, for a period of **twenty-four (24) months from the date of Final Acceptance** (the "**Cooling-off Period**"), the Service Provider shall not, and shall ensure that its Affiliates shall not, design, develop, deploy, license or provide any credit early-warning, delinquency-prediction or similar credit-risk monitoring model or service to any Regulated Lender in India, whether or not derived from the Lumen EWS Model
Final Acceptance**" means the Bank's written acceptance of Milestone M4 under SOW-1

Regulated Lender**" means any bank, small finance bank, cooperative bank, non-banking financial company, housing finance company or other lender regulated by the Reserve Bank of India or the National Housing Bank

The Bank may waive Clause 10.2 in writing for a specific engagement. Any request shall be made at least thirty (30) days before the Service Provider submits a proposal to the relevant Regulated Lender

findings.counterPosition: Seek a written waiver from Lumen Small Finance Bank Ltd for this engagement, or consult legal counsel regarding the timeline constraints.

findings.title: Uncapped liability for data protection incidents
findings.impact: AtliQ faces unlimited exposure to financial damages in the event of a data protection incident.

citations.docTitle: Indus Valley Co-operative Bank services agreement (draft)
citations.quote: Each party's aggregate liability capped at total fees, except for breach of confidentiality, data protection or fraud

findings.standard: Each party's aggregate liability capped at 1× fees (paid or payable in the prior 12 months), mutual; carve-outs only for fraud, wilful misconduct and confidentiality (plus any carve-outs that are mandatory under the governing law, e.g. German law for intent/gross negligence and injury).
findings.counterPosition: Subject data protection liability to a separate super-cap (such as 2x total fees) rather than leaving it uncapped.

3.1 Total fees: INR 98,50,000 (approx. USD 118,000) plus GST, payable per Annexure A.

3.2 Undisputed invoices payable within forty-five (45) days.

hits.heading: FEES AND PAYMENT
hits.label: standard
hits.text:
4.1 The total fees for the Services are **USD 48,000** (United States Dollars Forty-Eight Thousand only), payable on completion of Milestones as set out in Annexure A.

4.2 The Service Provider shall raise an invoice upon completion of each Milestone. The Company shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days of receipt of the invoice.

4.3 All fees are exclusive of GST. The Company shall be entitled to deduct TDS as applicable.

4.4 Any disputed amount shall be notified within ten (10) days of receipt of invoice, and the Parties shall resolve such dispute in good faith within thirty (30) days.
hits.differs: Same as Trustline NBFC: both set the payment timeframe for undisputed invoices at forty-five (45) days.

hits.heading: FEES AND PAYMENT
hits.label: untagged
hits.text:
5.1 The total Fees under SOW-1 are **USD 33,000** (United States Dollars Thirty-Three Thousand only), comprising build fees payable on Milestones and a Monthly Support Fee for the support period, as detailed in SOW-1.

5.2 AtliQ shall invoice build fees upon completion of each Milestone and the Monthly Support Fee monthly in arrears. Sunrise shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.

5.3 All amounts are exclusive of GST, which shall be charged additionally at the applicable rate. Sunrise may deduct TDS as required by law.

5.4 Delayed payments shall attract interest at twelve percent (12%) per annum.
hits.differs: Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: undisputed invoices are payable within forty-five (45) days instead of thirty (30) days.

hits.heading: DELAY AND LIQUIDATED DAMAGES
hits.label: standard
hits.labelNote: Origin of the LD playbook: 0.5% of milestone/week, 5% cap, client delays excluded (Mar 2025)
hits.text:
7.1 If the Service Provider fails to complete a Milestone by the agreed date for reasons solely attributable to the Service Provider, the Service Provider shall pay liquidated damages at the rate of 0.5% (half percent) of the Milestone Fee of the delayed Milestone for each complete week of delay.

7.2 The aggregate liquidated damages in respect of any Milestone shall not exceed 5% (five percent) of the Milestone Fee of that Milestone.

7.3 No liquidated damages shall be payable where the delay is caused by the Client, including delayed access to data or systems, delayed review of Deliverables, or changes in scope, or by a Force Majeure event.

7.4 The Parties agree that the liquidated damages are a genuine pre-estimate of loss and shall be the Client's sole and exclusive remedy for delay.
hits.differs: Same as Acme Retail Group: both cap liquidated damages for delays at 5% of the affected milestone fee at 0.5% per week.

hits.heading: DELAY AND LIQUIDATED DAMAGES
hits.label: accident

hits.text:
9.1 If the Supplier fails to achieve any Key Date, the Supplier shall pay to the Customer liquidated damages in the amount of one per cent (1%) of the Contract Value for each day or part day by which the relevant Key Date is missed.

hits.heading: DELIVERY, ACCEPTANCE AND LIQUIDATED DAMAGES
hits.label: exception

hits.text:
10.1 The Supplier shall use all reasonable endeavours to achieve each Milestone by the date set out in the relevant SOW.

10.2 Each Deliverable shall be subject to acceptance testing by the Client within ten (10) Business Days of delivery against the acceptance criteria in the SOW. Deliverables not rejected in writing within that period shall be deemed accepted.

10.3 If the Supplier fails to achieve a Milestone by its due date for reasons attributable to the Supplier, the Supplier shall pay to the Client, as liquidated damages, one percent (1%) of the Fees payable for the affected Milestone for each complete week of delay, provided that the aggregate liquidated damages payable under this Agreement shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the total Fees payable under this Agreement.

10.4 The Parties agree that the liquidated damages in Clause 10.3 are a genuine pre-estimate of loss. No liquidated damages shall be payable for delay caused by the Client, its contractors, or a Force Majeure Event.
hits.differs: Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: liquidated damages are capped at 5% of the milestone fee at 0.5% per week instead of 1%.
